snippet.title: SpyHunt - Official Gameplay Trailer | Multiplayer Social Deduction Game
snippet.description:
Welcome to SpyHunt, a multiplayer social deduction game where players must blend in with AI-controlled citizens while completing objectives and avoiding detection.

Play SpyHunt on Steam:❤️
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3334280/SpyHunt/


One player becomes the Detective, tasked with identifying and eliminating real players hidden among dozens of NPCs. The Spies must act naturally, complete missions, and outsmart the Detective before it's too late.

🎮 Features:
• Multiplayer social deduction gameplay
• Blend in with AI citizens
• Complete secret missions
• Strategic deception and stealth

Explore a variety of unique locations, each offering new ways to hide, deceive, and survive
Can you spot the real players?



#SpyHunt #IndieGame #GameplayTrailer #SocialDeduction #MultiplayerGame #SteamGame #Gaming #IndieDev #StealthGame #DeceptionGame
